citation: M. Vivona, G. Greco, M. Spera, P. Fiorenza, F. Giannazzo, A. La Magna, F. Roccaforte, Ni Schottky barrier on heavily doped phosphorous implanted 4H-SiC, J. Phys. D: Appl. Phys. (2021), doi:10.1088/1361-6463/ac13f3
eligibility: Figure 3 caption: 'Experimental J-VF curves for Ni/4H-SiC Schottky diode under forward bias at different measurement temperatures in the range 25-115 C'; text: 'at various temperatures in the range 25-115 C (step of 15 C)' -> 7 temperatures, eligible (checked from captions and text before any curve was extracted)
figure: Fig. 3: forward J-V at 25-115 C, step 15 C, Ni (100 nm, not annealed) on P-implanted 4H-SiC
N_D_source: 'The barrier PhiB_TFE and the doping concentration ND were determined as parameters of the TFE fit to the experimental J-VF curve, obtaining PhiB_TFE = 1.77 eV and ND = 1.97x10^19 cm-3.' (Fig. 2, 25 C, a fit-set temperature); 'Such donor concentration is in agreement with the value measured by scanning capacitance microscopy (SCM) of the active dopant profile'. The SIMS peak 1x10^20 cm-3 is the chemical P concentration over 200 nm, not the active donor density, so the active value is used (depletion width ~10 nm, inside the implanted layer). Choice recorded before the Fig. 3 curves were opened.
units_note: I_A holds current DENSITY in A/cm^2 (the figure plots J); contacts 250 um diameter
